newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Light names CITIC's Yung to board.
newsitem.headline: China Light names CITIC's Yung to board.

text.p: China Light & Power Ltd said on Monday it had appointed Larry Yung and John Leigh to its board of directors, effective immediately.

Yung is chairman of CITIC Pacific Ltd, which said on January 28 it would buy a 20 percent stake in China Light. Yung is also an executive director of China's state-owned China International Trust and Investment Corp (CITIC).
Leigh is a director of Sir Elly Kadoorie & Sons Ltd and a former legal advisor and company secretary of China Light.
The Kadoorie family is China Light's controlling shareholder. Michael Kadoorie is chairman of the utility firm.
China Light, one of Hong Kong's two electricity generators, said the appointments were made upon completion of the first tranche of its placement of shares to CITIC Pacific.
The company is to place a total of 497.66 million new shares at HK$32.66 each with CITIC Pacific.
China Light said previously that Andrew McAulay, nephew of the chairman and son of long-standing director R.J. McAulay, had been appointed to the board, effective February 1.
